coverage: 17 distinct payer/trigger/outcome cases: 10 company-paid (5 delegation, 2 obscure production, 3 principal-system coexistence); 5 individual/prosumer convenience; 2 premium-differential. This is a partial formal batch of 761-860 and NOT 100 completed cases.
notes: No outreach, buyer interviews or builds. M4 awards are award values NOT proof funds disbursed. S3 requires independent buyer-side evidence, not vendor testimonials. Three status groupings: 15 directional kills (some previously adjacent), one CAD anomaly, one catalogue banked lead; zero outreach-ready and zero build-ready. Not every prior numbered-case promotion gate is met: no promoted case here.

cases.trigger: signed construction mark-ups need issued as-built DWG
cases.selection_evidence: Named client outsourced for 10+ projects over >1yr plus independent Trustpilot buyers (actual rate not established)
cases.complete_job: Redline PDF + original DWG => correct native DWG and PDF revision, not an annotation summary
cases.repeat_AI_test: AI repeat can spot notes, cannot reliably implement altered engineering geometry or final QA
cases.AI_build_test: AI code can transform DXF, not guarantee accepted DWG; ODA SaaS SDK $7,500 first year
cases.first_ten_route: ECA/NICEIC and electrical subcontractor directories, not ten verified buyers
cases.strongest_kill: High recurring real buyer demand, but incumbent human QA and proprietary DWG rights/engineering accuracy raise operations/capital
cases.next_falsification: Obtain de-identified before/after DWG+redline samples and quantify percentage safely auto-resolvable; if specialist review stays per drawing, kill

cases.trigger: country/language-specific catalogues due from structured product records
cases.observed_spend: Named ROBUS retained outsourced catalogue-page production; no public contract price
cases.selection_evidence: Vendor-named ROBUS continuation after initial year, not independent buyer invoice
cases.complete_job: PIM/Excel product records => consistently typeset reviewed printed/digital catalogue pages
cases.repeat_AI_test: AI repeat drafts pages but cannot guarantee print exact output and cross-language pagination
cases.AI_build_test: AI-build would duplicate mature EasyCatalog/AutoPub plus client-specific integration
cases.first_ten_route: Lighting and foodservice distributors with recurring catalogues; first ten not enumerated
cases.strongest_kill: No separable money trail for a fresh entrant; expensive integration, paid agency builds templates and manages exceptions
cases.next_falsification: Independent buyer says paid to produce pages outside existing PIM and would pay a new self-serve service

cases.trigger: tender PDF drawings require priced/measured BOQ
cases.selection_evidence: Professionally delivered independent take-off already transacted as offer
cases.complete_job: Drawings+specification => measured BOQ with signed-off quantities and exceptions
cases.repeat_AI_test: AI repeated measurements poor for complex/symbol-dependent sheets without QS verification
cases.AI_build_test: AI-build takeoff available £195/month and £50/project evidence pack
cases.first_ten_route: Construction subcontractor associations, ten direct buyer matches unverified
cases.strongest_kill: Quantity certification and QS judgement carry liability; cheap automation and existing services
cases.next_falsification: Do not revive without independently proven paid unsolved sub-deliverable

cases.trigger: annotated images needed to train/test model
cases.selection_evidence: Priced separate annotation output; buyer purchase not verified
cases.complete_job: Image sets + labeling schema => accepted QA'd labels/segmentation masks
cases.repeat_AI_test: AI prelabels but independent human gold labels needed for accuracy
cases.AI_build_test: AI-built labeling interface easy and sold by incumbent human QA marketplace
cases.first_ten_route: UK ML teams/dataset procurement, no verified ten
cases.strongest_kill: Priced 4p/label, buyer primarily buys trusted human QA and managed workforce

cases.trigger: needs accurate time-coded delivery subtitles for published film
cases.selection_evidence: Provider quotes named corporate client reference, no verified paid invoice
cases.complete_job: Audio+video => corrected timecodes, translated/approved caption file and finished video
cases.repeat_AI_test: AI repeat can transcribe/caption, cannot fully QA specialist jargon and translations
cases.AI_build_test: AI-build mostly Whisper + timeline editor and low-cost caption provider
cases.first_ten_route: UK production houses; no ten counted
cases.strongest_kill: Commodity automated captioning starts far below manual service, which covers expert QA
cases.next_falsification: Do not build lower-quality commodity alternative

cases.trigger: book near print deadline needs proper navigable index
cases.selection_evidence: Society-listed freelance indexers sell standalone deliverables; paid author instance not verified
cases.complete_job: Fully edited back-of-book concept index with exact cross-references and pagination
cases.repeat_AI_test: Society's tests say repetitive LLM indexing produces inadequate complete indexes
cases.AI_build_test: AI-build index generator easy, verified semantic index requires specialist judgement
cases.first_ten_route: Society indexer directory/publisher acquisition not first-ten buyers
cases.strongest_kill: Independent professional judgement and one-off throughput dominate; no defensible unattended validator

cases.trigger: remote room redesign with purchase-ready shopping list
cases.selection_evidence: Complete remote paid package includes expert taste and consultation
cases.complete_job: Photos/dimensions/preferences => accepted shoppable furnished room proposal
cases.repeat_AI_test: Repeated general AI can mock up a room but style and fit require human agreement
cases.first_ten_route: UK homeowners via retail forums; cost of acquisition unsupported
cases.strongest_kill: Paying for taste, trust and designer iteration, not data assembly
cases.next_falsification: No standalone software result carrying £400 value

cases.trigger: career move triggers professionally rewritten CV
cases.selection_evidence: Published services plus vendor-hosted customer quotations; not independent payment evidence
cases.complete_job: Personal history + job brief => tailored CV and profile acceptable to recruiter
cases.repeat_AI_test: General AI repeats rewriting given history; human interview/coaching differentiates higher end
cases.AI_build_test: AI-building format/rewrite commodity; interview guarantees cannot be delivered by software
cases.first_ten_route: Job seekers easily reached but expensive consumer CAC
cases.strongest_kill: No defensible automatic finished career outcome, trust and outcomes sold
cases.next_falsification: Do not repackage a CV prompt as product

cases.trigger: institutional thesis deadline, formal presentation acceptance
cases.observed_spend: £200 full thesis layout on Fiverr, 128 orders and 71 reviews
cases.selection_evidence: Marketplace explicitly reports completed orders and customer reviews (not verified buyer invoice or price of each order)
cases.complete_job: Student file + public university spec => corrected Word/PDF thesis accepted for deposit
cases.repeat_AI_test: Repeated AI+Word macro can fix simpler formatting but not many manual figures/table flows
cases.AI_build_test: AI-build possible but existing cheap freelance services £1/page and university templates
cases.first_ten_route: University postgraduate communities, no first-ten willingness
cases.strongest_kill: One-off narrow consumer purchase, low margin/CAC and human Word repair exceptions
cases.next_falsification: Requires extraordinary self-serve distribution to reopen

cases.trigger: wedding invitations need calligraphy on envelopes
cases.selection_evidence: Purchase includes inked physical invitations, packaging and delivery
cases.complete_job: Software cannot deliver hand-written envelopes as sold; font render would be a cheaper different item
cases.repeat_AI_test: AI generates printable font/name merge, not tactile hand-calligraphy
cases.AI_build_test: AI-build trivial digital layout; physical premium survives
cases.first_ten_route: Wedding planners and stationery shops, but job inherently physical
cases.strongest_kill: Handcrafted product rather than digital completion

cases.observed_spend: £240 vs £160 for 10,000 words (48-hour vs 5-day); £80 speed premium
cases.selection_evidence: Buyer specifically buys rush human subject-matched editorial plus two reviewers
cases.complete_job: Complete language and structure edit with tracked changes and accountable human quality
cases.incumbent: Existing service itself supplies trained, human-reviewed rush editing; free or subscription general writing/proofreading AI is adequate for routine language fixes but not the entire expert deliverable.
cases.repeat_AI_test: AI can draft edit, but repeat rigorous academic language judgment not independently accepted
cases.AI_build_test: AI writing-app easy; speed premium is human capacity/review guarantees
cases.first_ten_route: University students; no repeat purchase volume
cases.strongest_kill: Urgency pays for reserved specialist labour and liability, not deterministic turnaround
cases.next_falsification: Do not seek rushed human editorial fees via SaaS

cases.payer: UK estate agency or home seller
cases.trigger: listing visual needs bespoke professionally staged furniture
cases.observed_spend: £90 bespoke image vs automated £5/mo starting alternative
cases.selection_evidence: Bespoke image supplied digitally but commercial premium buys personal art direction; seller offers £90 each
cases.complete_job: Original room photo => trustworthy professionally styled virtual staging image
cases.repeat_AI_test: Image AI can repeat commodity staging if scenes straightforward
cases.AI_build_test: Existing self-serve £5/month or £30/10-photo product; no independent residual fee to capture
cases.first_ten_route: Estate agents publicly accessible; no ten exact buyers
cases.strongest_kill: Price differential is personal style, curation and trust; entering cheap tier already crowded

cases.trigger: fragile archival records require digitisation and transcript
cases.selection_evidence: Award notice explicitly says fragile archives, specialised digitisation, direct award for technical reasons
cases.complete_job: Physically scan delicate originals then transcribe, validate, deliver searchable archive
cases.repeat_AI_test: AI helps OCR but cannot access or safely scan fragile documents
cases.AI_build_test: AI-built OCR partial; purchased full job physical/specialist
cases.first_ten_route: Public archives visible but this bespoke award technically restrictive
cases.strongest_kill: Large official money is emphatically not capturable with low-touch software
cases.next_falsification: No attempt to replicate physical specialist archive service

cases.trigger: large supplier SKU records need typed, mapped, verified structured attributes
cases.selection_evidence: Supplier-data enrichment is separately offered, but established provider also sells ingest system
cases.complete_job: Supplier PDFs/assets/spreadsheets => verified category/taxonomy mapped PIM records
cases.repeat_AI_test: AI repeatedly fills straightforward fields, but image/fitment and supplier source truth require QA
cases.AI_build_test: AI-built supplier portal exact existing SKULaunch; data licensing, access and QA
cases.first_ten_route: Ireland/UK wholesalers directory, no ten verified buyers
cases.strongest_kill: Adequate existing integrated service and margin tight at lower SKU pricing
cases.next_falsification: Do not revive generic SKU enrichment

cases.trigger: migrate WooCommerce live store to Shopify incl redirects and cutover
cases.observed_spend: £1,399 managed migration incl theme and launch; £2,500+ agencies exist
cases.selection_evidence: Seller operates app alongside independently priced done-for-you migration; named buyer examples other vendors not payment proof
cases.complete_job: Source store+Shopify access => validated live products/orders/redirects/theme, safe cutover
cases.repeat_AI_test: AI repeated handles field mapping but cannot guarantee redirects, checkout and safe production cutover
cases.AI_build_test: AI-built migration via APIs possible, but paid competitor itself already automates, humans cover exceptions
cases.first_ten_route: Shopify Partners / ecommerce merchant groups; no ten merchants proved underserved
cases.strongest_kill: One-off large credential and go-live liability; established automated+done-for-you competitor
cases.next_falsification: Only revisit buyer shows switching to third provider despite comparable guaranteed full cutover

cases.trigger: missing inventory/fees need claim filed and Amazon reimbursement issued
cases.observed_spend: 20%+ of recovered FBA funds; some offers explicitly 25%
cases.selection_evidence: GETIDA sells contingent-fee claim-to-reimbursement completion; vendor-hosted testimonials and marketing are not independent buyer-side selection evidence for S3.
cases.complete_job: Seller Central access + evidence => actual accepted reimbursement, not report or alert
cases.repeat_AI_test: AI can prepare cases repeatedly but cannot compel Amazon acceptance or acquire private evidence independently
cases.AI_build_test: AI-built new claimant duplicates established platform-authorised integration; API access friction
cases.first_ten_route: Amazon sellers reachable, but incumbent at 20–25% already performs entire recovery
cases.strongest_kill: This is demonstrably separable paid service but exact incumbent C3 and principal system private oracle make entry implausible
cases.next_falsification: Do not revive reimbursement monoculture without evidenced underserved selection

cases.observed_spend: FCA awarded £90,427 to Chorus April 2026 (award, not expenditure realised)
cases.selection_evidence: Independent buyer procurement award for software data-cleaning output; no new-entrant access proven
cases.complete_job: Sensitive regulatory inputs => configured, supportable enterprise data cleansing process
cases.repeat_AI_test: General AI cleans extracts but fails enterprise data lineage/security/reproducibility
cases.AI_build_test: AI-build technically possible but accreditation, protected data, framework eligibility beyond solo fit
cases.first_ten_route: UK framework route is selective and SME suitability negative
cases.strongest_kill: Best proof buyer buys independent software; worst founder distribution and liability
cases.next_falsification: Observe smaller non-sensitive procurement with same bounded outcome
